author: Wise
text: 1d What a night, Singapore! 🎉 🇸🇬 Last week at Wise’s Singapore office, Wise Business brought founders, investors and expansion experts together to discuss what it takes to expand into APAC and beyond, including how to turn bold ambitions into high-impact strategies. A few takeaways from the panel: - Customer-first, globally - Every market is a whole new world. Expanding into a new country, even those nearby like Vietnam or Thailand, requires a focused market and customer assessment. - More than market size - Just because Indonesia has over 280 million consumers, that doesn’t mean it’s the right fit for your business. Think about your ‘route to market’ and consider where your demand is coming from now. - Boots on the ground - Managing your growth remotely may not be enough to win in your target market. True insight and high-quality decisions come from local expertise. As one panellist put it: ‘Double your travel budget.’ A big thank you to our expert panellists Matthew Beaven, Rufus Sorsa, Zong Xi SIA and Frank Bomers, and to our host Krissy T.. 👏 And thanks to everyone who joined us for pizza, bubble tea and shared their questions and perspectives on scaling in APAC and beyond. Missed the event or want expert views on international expansion?
